package.name: qore-oracle-module
package.title: Qore Oracle database driver and extensions
package.description: Open-source Oracle driver, source/AOT extensions, metadata and documentation. Canonical local x86_64 RPMs and offline runtime/SDK, lifecycle and debugger checks pass on Fedora, AlmaLinux and openSUSE against Oracle's separately supplied signed client RPMs. Proprietary client sources or binaries are not included. Builds remain disabled pending a confirmed permitted client dependency route; live database and native ARM qualification remain outstanding.
